title: Twining: best brains in the Air Force

tellings.quote: According to the 1971 Australian intelligence document, US Air Force Chief of Staff General Nathan Twining stated that the best brains in the Air Force are working

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, cites a 1971 Australian intelligence document. According to Michels, the document states that General Nathan Twining, the head of the US Air Force, said in the 1950s that the best brains in the Air Force were working on the subject. If true, it would mean the Air Force took the flying saucer question very seriously at the top.
